title: API sözleşmesi yalnız platform yöneticisine açık
summary: openapi_url kapatıldı ve /openapi.json PlatformAdminDep arkasına alındı; 0016 migration'ı audit beyaz listesini ve tablo CHECK kısıtını yeni yüzey için genişletir. Belge sayfası jeton kapısıyla açılır.

behavior.guardrail_revision: api-contract-admin-gate-v1: openapi yalnız platform yöneticisi, her deneme audit'te

evaluation.human_anchor_ref: not-run: yetki kapısı; kanıt testler ve canlı deneme
evaluation.exact_command: set -euo pipefail; cd apps/api && TEST_DB_NAME=dou_synapse_test_gate .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && .venv/bin/ruff check . && .venv/bin/mypy app; cd ../.. && node scripts/docs_check.mjs; apps/api/.venv/bin/python scripts/ai_sdlc_check.py --base-sha ba69ff9eec0a2867614dd145eb6e995f6c0af5ac --head-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"

rollout.kill_switch: Set COURSE_AGENT_ENABLED=false and restart or redeploy the API; chat must fail closed before retrieval, provider calls or new artifacts.
rollout.assignment: Sticky per user and course after an internal instructor-only staging pilot, then a small sticky student cohort.
rollout.initial_exposure: None; code is not deployed. First exposure is internal instructor-only staging with active exams excluded.
stop_conditions: Any cross-role, cross-course or student-content disclosure.
Any active-exam chat or export bypass, quota overshoot or unbounded provider call.
Any citation, scope, kill-switch or rollback fail-open behavior.
expand_conditions: Exact provider and model are pinned and the frozen real-provider holdout passes.
Staging auth, storage, RLS and rollback rehearsal pass.
Engineering, domain and security or privacy approvals are recorded.
rollout.active_exam_policy: No student cohort is exposed during active exams; API and export remain fail-closed under the shared user assessment lock.

rollback.procedure: Revert commit; openapi_url varsayılana döner. 0016 additive'dir (yalnız liste genişletir), geri alınması gerekmez.
rollback.verification: Tam pytest + kapı testleri eski ağaçta yeşil.

privacy.handling: Only synthetic fixture identities, repository paths, hashes, stable error codes and aggregate counts are retained.
privacy.retention: Versioned with the repository; raw prompts, answers, chunks, filenames, emails, secrets, operation-row identifiers and provider payloads are excluded.
